_comment: ADCC 2026 women's -65 kg / +65 kg sourcing batch, 2026-08-19.
44 sourced rows collapse to 28 distinct videos: a reel was listed once per bout it
contains, and two IBJJF uploads were reached from both athletes' sides. frame_pdf.py
collapses by video id, so the repeats are simply absent here.
The three reels carry `skip` rather than being deleted. A reel that exists and was
deliberately not rendered is a different fact from a fight nobody found footage for,
and only the first is worth re-reading if the sourcing rule changes. A highlight reel
shows the finishes and cuts the position work, so a sequence read off one is not a
record of the fight -- it is a record of the edit.
That leaves Livia Barasine with no renderable footage at all: her only listed source is
the Brazil Trials reel. She is also withheld from publication (WITHHELD_ATHLETE_NAMES),
so nothing about her would publish either way -- but the gap is hers to close with a
full-bout source, not something to paper over with the reel.
`start`/`end` are VIDEO-ABSOLUTE seconds inside the file at `url`. Both omitted means
the whole video. hO_ojTdvoc0 is a 2h33 full event: the first pass is a locator at a
widened step, then re-run that row with start/end and the normal step.
